description: LIST tool. Even detail='full' OMITS article bodies (kept bounded) — to read an article's content, call get_blog_article. The number of rows is controlled by `limit` (default 50, max 200), NOT by `detail`; for a 'full list' of titles, raise `limit` and keep detail='short', and page past 200 with `offset`. On a brand publishing in more than one language (see get_brand_languages), publications and articles both carry `languageCode` — check it before generating into a publication, since two publications with the same brand can differ only by language.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

offset.description: Articles to skip, for paging (pair with limit)

updatedSince.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only articles updated at or after this. For incremental sync prefer list_content_changes.

name: list_blogs
